C0448.title: Guizhou Bainian Yuanzhi Liquor Falsified Inventory Tax Evasion Case
C0448.summary: In August 2025, Guizhou tax authorities announced a tax-evasion case involving Guizhou Bainian Yuanzhi Liquor Co., Ltd. Investigators found that from January 2019 to June 2023 the company concealed income by falsifying inventory, selling at low prices through affiliated companies, and improperly deducting accrued expenses, underpaying value-added tax, consumption tax, corporate income tax, and other taxes by 8.6983 million yuan. On January 18, 2024, the Qiannan Prefecture Tax Bureau Inspection Bureau ordered the company to pay back taxes, late fees, and fines totaling 13.806 million yuan.
